name: Creative / Digital Agency
description: Organization structure for a creative, digital, or advertising agency operating on a client service model. Covers the dual structure of Account/Client Services (managing client relationships) and Creative/Production (delivering the work). Includes strategy and planning, creative direction, design and copywriting, production and project management, finance, and new business development. Designed for agencies of 10-300 people serving multiple clients across campaigns, branding, digital products, and content.

org_structure.overview: Creative agencies operate on a client service model where Account/Client Services teams manage client relationships, scope, and expectations while Creative and Production teams execute the work. The agency is typically organized into departments (Account, Creative, Strategy, Production, Finance, New Business) but staff are assembled into cross-functional project teams for each client or campaign. The agency model is relationship-driven: Account Directors own the client relationship, Creative Directors own the creative vision, and Project Managers keep everything on time and on budget. Agencies must balance high-quality creative output with profitability, making resource management and scope control critical. New business (pitching and winning new clients) is a continuous priority that cuts across all departments.

departments.name: Agency Leadership
departments.description: Executive team that sets the agency's creative vision, business strategy, and culture. Manages the agency's P&L, key client relationships, and new business direction. Typically founded or led by creative and business partners.

roles.title: CEO / Managing Director
roles.description: Sets agency vision, culture, and strategy. Manages the P&L, key client relationships, and executive team.

roles.title: Chief Creative Officer (CCO) / Executive Creative Director
roles.description: Sets the agency's creative vision and quality standards. Leads creative department and oversees creative output across all clients.

roles.title: Chief Strategy Officer (CSO)
roles.description: Leads strategy/planning discipline. Sets the agency's strategic approach and ensures strategies drive creative work.

roles.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
roles.description: Manages agency operations, resourcing, finance, and systems. Ensures projects are profitable and processes scale.

roles.title: Chief Growth Officer (CGO)
roles.description: Leads new business development, pitches, and agency marketing. Drives revenue growth through new client acquisition.

departments.name: Account / Client Services
departments.description: The client-facing team that manages relationships, defines scope, handles budgets and timelines, and ensures client satisfaction. Account people are the bridge between the client and the internal creative/production teams.

roles.title: Director of Account / Client Services
roles.description: Leads the account management discipline. Sets client service standards, manages account directors, and oversees client portfolio.

roles.title: Account Director / Group Account Director
roles.description: Owns the relationship with one or more major clients. Leads strategic conversations, manages contracts, and ensures client satisfaction and retention.

roles.title: Account Manager
roles.description: Manages day-to-day client communication, project briefs, status reports, and scope change requests.

roles.title: Account Executive
roles.description: Supports account team with meeting coordination, status updates, timesheet management, and administrative tasks.

roles.title: Account Coordinator / Junior AE
roles.description: Entry-level support role: maintains contact reports, tracks budgets, and organizes client materials.

departments.name: Strategy & Planning
departments.description: Provides the strategic foundation for creative work. Conducts audience research, competitive analysis, brand positioning, and messaging strategy. Ensures creative work is grounded in data and insights.

roles.title: Strategy Director / Head of Planning
roles.description: Leads the strategy discipline; sets strategic approach for client engagements and new business pitches.

roles.title: Brand Strategist
roles.description: Develops brand positioning, messaging architecture, and brand strategy for clients.

roles.title: Communications / Media Strategist
roles.description: Develops channel strategy, media plans, and audience targeting strategies.

roles.title: Cultural / Consumer Insights Strategist
roles.description: Conducts consumer research, trend analysis, and cultural insights to inform creative strategy.

roles.title: Data / Analytics Strategist
roles.description: Analyzes campaign performance data, conducts quantitative research, and generates actionable insights.

departments.name: Creative
departments.description: The core creative engine of the agency. Produces advertising concepts, design, copywriting, and visual content across all media. Organized into creative teams (art director + copywriter pairs) overseen by creative directors.

roles.title: Creative Director
roles.description: Leads the creative vision for a client or set of accounts. Guides creative teams and approves creative output.

roles.title: Associate Creative Director
roles.description: Manages day-to-day creative output of assigned teams; develops concepts and oversees execution.

roles.title: Art Director
roles.description: Creates visual concepts and designs for campaigns, digital experiences, branding, and advertising.

roles.title: Copywriter
roles.description: Writes advertising copy, headlines, social content, video scripts, and brand messaging.

roles.title: Senior Designer
roles.description: Produces high-quality design across print, digital, and motion. Mentors junior designers.

roles.title: Designer
roles.description: Executes design assets for campaigns, social media, presentations, and other deliverables.

roles.title: Junior Designer / Design Intern
roles.description: Entry-level designer supporting the creative team with production tasks, asset creation, and file preparation.

roles.title: Motion Designer / Animator
roles.description: Creates animated content, motion graphics, video editing, and visual effects for campaigns.

roles.title: Junior / Associate Creative Team (Art + Copy)
roles.description: Early-career art director and copywriter pair developing concepts under senior guidance.

departments.name: Production & Project Management
departments.description: Ensures creative projects are delivered on time, on budget, and at quality. Manages project timelines, resources, vendor relationships, and production workflows across all media types.

roles.title: Director of Project Management / Production
roles.description: Leads project management discipline; establishes workflows, tools, and standards for project delivery.

roles.title: Senior Project Manager / Producer
roles.description: Manages complex, multi-workstream projects for major clients. Owns timeline, budget tracking, and resource coordination.

roles.title: Project Manager
roles.description: Manages individual projects or workstreams; creates timelines, manages budgets, and facilitates team communication.

roles.title: Traffic Manager / Resource Coordinator
roles.description: Manages resource allocation and routing of work across creative teams; ensures balanced workloads.

roles.title: Junior Project Manager / Coordinator
roles.description: Supports project managers with timeline tracking, status updates, and administrative tasks.

roles.title: Digital / Interactive Producer
roles.description: Produces digital deliverables including websites, apps, and digital campaigns; coordinates with developers.

roles.title: Print / Broadcast Producer
roles.description: Manages production of print, video, or audio assets; hires and directs external vendors and production partners.

roles.title: QA / Proofreader
roles.description: Reviews all deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and quality before client delivery.

departments.name: Digital / Technology
departments.description: Provides technical expertise for digital projects including web development, app development, CRM/email platforms, and technical architecture. May be embedded in creative teams for digital-first projects.

roles.title: Director of Technology / Digital
roles.description: Leads the technology discipline; sets technical standards, tooling, and capability.

roles.title: Technical / Creative Developer
roles.description: Builds websites, interactive experiences, and digital campaigns using front-end technologies.

roles.title: Backend / Full-Stack Developer
roles.description: Builds server-side applications, APIs, and integrations for client projects.

roles.title: UX / Interaction Designer
roles.description: Designs user flows, wireframes, and prototypes for digital products and experiences.

roles.title: Technology / Solutions Architect
roles.description: Designs technical architecture for complex digital projects and platforms.

roles.title: QA / Tester (Digital)
roles.description: Tests digital deliverables across browsers and devices; manages bug tracking and quality.

roles.title: CRM / Marketing Automation Specialist
roles.description: Implements and manages CRM platforms, email marketing tools, and marketing automation systems.

departments.name: New Business / Growth
departments.description: Drives agency growth by identifying and winning new clients. Manages the pitch process, agency marketing / PR, thought leadership, and proposal development. Requires collaboration across all departments to produce winning pitches.

roles.title: Director of New Business / Growth
roles.description: Leads new business pipeline; identifies opportunities, manages pitch process, and coordinates proposal teams.

roles.title: New Business Manager
roles.description: Researches prospects, manages CRM pipeline, and coordinates RFP responses and pitch materials.

roles.title: Agency Marketing / PR Manager
roles.description: Promotes the agency through PR, award show entries, case studies, social media, and events.

roles.title: Proposal / Pitch Coordinator
roles.description: Coordinates logistics and production of pitch presentations and proposal documents.

departments.name: Finance & Operations
departments.description: Manages agency financial health: billing, payroll, budgeting, forecasting, and profitability analysis. Tracks utilization rates, project profitability, and overhead. May also manage HR for smaller agencies.

roles.title: Finance Director / Controller
roles.description: Oversees agency financial management including P&L, cash flow, billing, and financial reporting.

roles.title: Accountant / Bookkeeper
roles.description: Processes invoices, payroll, expense reports, and accounts payable/receivable.

roles.title: Billing / Revenue Manager
roles.description: Manages client billing, timesheet reconciliation, and revenue recognition.

roles.title: HR / People Manager
roles.description: Manages hiring, onboarding, benefits, performance reviews, and agency culture.

roles.title: Office / Facilities Manager
roles.description: Manages office operations, supplies, and vendor relationships for physical workspace.

key_relationships: Account Directors are the primary client relationship owners; they brief Creative teams and manage scope and budget with client sign-off.
Creative Directors set the creative vision and quality bar; they partner with Account Directors to sell work to clients and defend creative concepts.
Strategy informs creative briefs; Creative teams depend on Strategy for the insights and positioning that inspire great work.
Project Managers are the hub of every project: they coordinate timelines between Account, Creative, and Production, and escalate risks to Account and agency leadership.
New Business pitches involve Account, Creative, Strategy, and Production teams working intensively together under tight deadlines; the pitch team is assembled cross-functionally.
Finance tracks project profitability and utilization; Account Directors and Project Managers must maintain margin targets and flag over-servicing.
Production/Resource Management assigns creative teams to projects based on skills, availability, and budget; Traffic Manager balances workloads across the department.
Digital/Technology collaborates with Creative on interactive and digital projects; a Creative Technologist or Developer may be embedded in the creative team.
Media/Communications Strategist partners with the Account team on media buying, channel planning, and campaign performance reporting for clients that need media execution.
External vendors (photographers, video production, printers, developers) are managed by Production; the Account team ensures vendor costs are covered in client scope.

│     │     ├── Communications / Media Strategists
│     │     ├── Consumer Insights Strategists
│     │     └── Data / Analytics Strategists
│     └── ...
│
├── Director of Account / Client Services

│     │     │     ├── Project Managers
│     │     │     └── Junior PMs / Coordinators
│     │     ├── Traffic Manager / Resource Coordinator
│     │     ├── Digital / Interactive Producers
│     │     ├── Print / Broadcast Producers
│     │     └── QA / Proofreader
│     ├── Director of Technology / Digital
│     │     ├── Creative Developers
│     │     ├── Backend / Full-Stack Developers
│     │     ├── UX / Interaction Designers
│     │     ├── Solutions Architect
│     │     └── QA / Tester (Digital)
│     └── Finance Director / Controller
│           ├── Accountant / Bookkeeper

Note: Cross-functional teams assemble per client. Each client has an Account Director,
Creative Director, and Project Manager as the core team leads.
